newsitem.title: UK: Capital Group, Liberty Intl Pensions in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Capital Group, Liberty Intl Pensions in alliance.

text.p: Britain's Capital Group International Inc said on Monday it would buy a 10 percent stake in Liberty International Pensions as part of a wider alliance between the fund manager and pensions provider.

Capital Group International is member of the Capital Group Companies Inc, which manages funds worth over 150 billion stg. Liberty International Pensions is part of financial services group Liberty International Holdings Plc.
Capital Group's affiliate Capital International Ltd has been appointed as the preferred investment manager of the active global equities fund of Liberty International Pensions.
Liberty International Pensions, which operates under the name PensionStore, becomes the Capital International's preferred provider in Britain for money purchase purchase pension services.
